nodes.label: Keep
nodes.rationale: Provide real terminal persistence while keeping a simpler workspace-and-tabs mental model than tmux.

nodes.label: Flat Workspace and Tabs Model
nodes.rationale: A workspace maps to a project and contains tabs, avoiding tmux's additional windows-and-panes hierarchy.

nodes.label: Daemon-Client Architecture
nodes.rationale: The process-owning terminal must outlive a closable window, so Keep separates persistent PTY and screen ownership into a daemon from attachable clients.

nodes.label: Private Working Directory Handoff
nodes.rationale: The linked libghostty build ignores per-surface command, environment, and initial-input fields, so the app passes each target through a private working-directory file that the client consumes and deletes.

nodes.label: SwiftUI NSView Metal Bridge
nodes.rationale: SwiftUI cannot draw a character grid at frame rate, so the terminal surface is an NSView rendered with Metal and bridged through NSViewRepresentable.

nodes.label: Pinned libghostty ABI Strategy
nodes.rationale: libghostty-vt has no stable ABI, so the vendored tip build is pinned and keep-vt asserts the C structure sizes it was built against.
